description: Backend-reported usage recorded since tracking was enabled, including spawned agents. One AI credit is 1,000,000,000 nano AIU. Usage is not an invoice or an amount owed.

estimatedNanoUsd.description: API-equivalent USD in billionths, only for responses without a backend charge. Null means no estimates are available. Add to the USD value of nano_aiu.

partial.description: Some attempts have neither a backend charge nor a usable token estimate.
